description: This file defines functions for computing CSP hashes for inline scripts within HTML content and building Content Security Policy (CSP) headers specifically for control UI elements. It includes regex patterns for script attribute detection and constructs the CSP header string based on optional inline script hashes.

methods.name: computeInlineScriptHashes
methods.description: Calculates SHA-256 hashes for inline `<script>` blocks in an HTML string, ignoring scripts with `src` attributes.

methods.name: buildControlUiCspHeader
methods.description: Creates a CSP header string with specified directives, optionally including hashes for inline scripts.
